messages:
arun: Quick heads-up — bringing up a new candidate model (hf/dahlia-6b-raw) and hit a reproducible divergence between fp16 and q4_dyn on the runtime. Short repro and notes below. Can we triage prioritization for onboarding + quant experiments?

arun: Repro steps (minimal):
```bash
# checkout runtime branch with latest rotary fix
python tests/run_inference.py --model hf/dahlia-6b-raw \\n  --prompt-file tests/prompts/small_chat.jsonl --max-tokens 128 \\n  --quant q4_dyn --device cuda:0 --batch 1
# then repeat with --quant fp16
```

arun: Observed behavior: first 40 tokens match, then starting ~tok 41 outputs diverge (different token choices). Not just sampling noise — beam/greedy identical divergence. Latency roughly the same but perplexity (measured against heldout next-token) jumps +7.1% for q4_dyn vs fp16.

arun: Attached paste of deterministic run (greedy) outputs:
```
FP16: ... "the committee recommended moving forward."
Q4_DYN: ... "the committee recommended moving backward."
Logit-diff-sample: token_idx=42, max_logit_fp16=8.12, max_logit_q4=5.97
```

arun: Runtime notes: we run with rotary fused kernels enabled, kv cache packed, and automatic KV index eviction off. Model uses RoPE with scale 1.0 in config.json.

lee: Thanks, Arun. Did you try disabling fused rotary (fall back to unfused CPU/naive kernel) to isolate runtime kernel vs quantization error?

arun: Yes — fallback to unfused kernel (software-rope) makes outputs align again (fp16 vs q4_dyn close), so suspect fused rotary+quant path interaction.

maria: Interesting. Could be Rope exponent / scale being applied with reduced precision in the fused kernel. Two hypotheses: (1) index range truncation when computing sin/cos in int8 path; (2) kv cache indexing/endianness bug that shows up only after fusion because memory layout changes.

sam: I ran a quick micro-bench: same model, synthetic inputs, single-layer probe. When fused-rope + q4_dyn, the cos/sin table values we generate on-device differ by ~3e-3 from host fp32 table (accumulated error at high position -> token shift). Link to raw numbers: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/dahlia-rotary-probe (perm).

lee: Good repro. Priority? If we can't gate this, some customer chat workloads will see semantics regressions. What gating thresholds do we want for onboarding?

maria: Proposed gating checklist for Dahlia-6B: list out short items
- Token-level equivalence window: greedy token agreement >= 99.5% for first 128 tokens between fp16 baseline and quant variant under same RNG.
- Perplexity delta <= 2% on our model-specific eval corpus.
- Downstream chat eval (ROUGE/BLEU/QA F1) within historical CI noise.
- KV stress: 8k context rolling with random segment lengths to trigger cache indexing; compare outputs for divergence rate.
- Perf: tokens/sec within 15% of fp16 baseline for deduped traffic.

arun: Those look good. For the KV stress test, I can add a focused harness that toggles fused-rope on/off and collects logit diffs per position. I'll attach results to the PR.

sam: Quick mitigation idea: we can add an interim fallback policy — if logit-diff at token t > threshold then switch to fp16 for subsequent tokens for that request. It buys us time while engineering finds root cause. Ops: small perf hit but preserves semantics. Thoughts?

maria: We should avoid per-request mode flips unless we can bound cost. Better to add a conservative runtime flag for Dahlia model family to disable fused-rope on quantized runtime for now. Easier to roll back.

infra-bot: deploy/canary finished for inference/runtime-fix-branch — 3 nodes, no crash alerts.

arun: Plan: 1) Add kv-indexing micro-harness + upload numeric diffs (in progress). 2) Run full gating suite (maria checklist). 3) If failure persists, set model-family config to disable fused-rope for q4 dyn and notify customers. 4) Parallel root-cause: reproduce minimal fused kernel routine and add higher-precision intermediate in sin/cos table.

lee: Assigning owners: arun -> micro-harness + PR; sam -> numeric table diff analysis and small kernel patch attempt; maria -> gating thresholds + update onboarding doc. I can handle config rollout once we have failing evidence.

qa-bot: Test run queued: dahlia-fp16-vs-q4dyn-gating (128t) — expected ~20m. Will post results here.

arun: Thanks all. I'll post the harness link + initial diffs in ~30m. @maria @lee ping if you want to review the repro logs early.
